words.enDefinition: a system that gives shoppers benefits for returning to a retailer

examples.en: I joined the loyalty programme because I bought groceries there every weekend.
examples.zh: 我每周末都去那家店买菜，于是加入了「会员奖励计划」。

examples.en: The loyalty programme let us earn points at both shops near the residence.
examples.zh: 通过这项「会员奖励计划」，我们在宿舍附近的两家店都能赚积分。

words.enDefinition: a personal account holding a shopper's rewards and programme information

examples.en: The cashier couldn't find my loyalty account until I gave my old email address.
examples.zh: 我报出旧邮箱后，收银员才找到我的「会员奖励账户」。

examples.en: I checked my loyalty account after buying the headphones at a participating store.
examples.zh: 我在参与活动的商店买完耳机后，查看了「会员奖励账户」。

collocations: sign in to a loyalty account

words.enDefinition: a card that identifies a shopper for a rewards scheme

examples.en: My loyalty card was still in the pocket of the coat I wore yesterday.
examples.zh: 我的「积分卡」还在昨天穿的外套口袋里。

examples.en: The cashier asked for my loyalty card before putting the shopping through the till.
examples.zh: 收银员在收银机上录入商品前，找我要了「积分卡」。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying an individual membership record

examples.en: The support adviser asked me to read out my membership number over the phone.
examples.zh: 客服请我在电话里念出「会员编号」。

examples.en: I found the membership number above my name on the welcome email from the shop.
examples.zh: 我在商店发来的欢迎邮件里，在名字上方找到了「会员编号」。

words.enDefinition: a scannable code identifying a customer as a programme member

examples.en: My phone screen dimmed while the cashier was scanning the member barcode at checkout.
examples.zh: 收银员结账时扫「会员条码」，我的手机屏幕变暗了。

examples.en: The app displayed the member barcode beneath my name on the account page.
examples.zh: 应用在账户页我的名字下方显示了「会员条码」。

words.enDefinition: to search a system for a person's membership details

examples.en: The clerk offered to look up a membership using my registered phone number.
examples.zh: 店员提出可以用我登记的手机号码「查找会员记录」。

examples.en: Could you look up a membership if I've left the loyalty card at home?
examples.zh: 如果我把积分卡落在家里了，你能「查找会员记录」吗？

collocations: look up a membership by name
look up a membership by phone number
ask staff to look up a membership

words.enDefinition: participation in a programme without a regular membership fee

examples.en: I chose the free membership because I only visited the shop once a month.
examples.zh: 我每月只去这家店一次，所以选了「免费会员资格」。

examples.en: The retailer introduced free membership for people who wanted to earn rewards on groceries.
examples.zh: 零售商为想靠买菜攒奖励的顾客推出了「免费会员资格」。

words.enDefinition: participation in a programme for which the member pays a fee

examples.en: The paid membership included delivery benefits that I rarely used during the summer.
examples.zh: 「付费会员资格」包含配送福利，不过我暑假很少用。

examples.en: I compared the paid membership with the free plan when my flatmate moved away.
examples.zh: 室友搬走后，我比较了「付费会员资格」和免费方案。

collocations: sign up for a paid membership

words.enDefinition: temporary access to a membership programme for evaluation

examples.en: I started a trial membership to see whether delivery reached our building reliably.
examples.zh: 我开通了「试用会员资格」，想看看配送能否稳定送到我们楼。

examples.en: My trial membership ended just before I placed the first order from home.
examples.zh: 我第一次从家里下单前，「试用会员资格」刚好结束了。

words.enDefinition: a membership billed or provided one month at a time

examples.en: I picked a monthly membership while I was living near the shop for summer.
examples.zh: 暑假住在店附近时，我选择了「按月会员」。

examples.en: The monthly membership was a better fit because my exchange ended in June.
examples.zh: 我的交换项目六月份就结束了，「按月会员」更合适。

words.enDefinition: a membership that can extend benefits to people at one address

examples.en: The household membership allowed me to add my partner from the same address.
examples.zh: 这项「同住成员会员计划」允许我把住在同一地址的伴侣加为会员。

examples.en: I checked whether the household membership would cover all the people in our flat.
examples.zh: 我问「同住成员会员计划」能不能覆盖公寓里同住的每个人。

words.enDefinition: the person responsible for the main membership on a shared account

examples.en: The primary member received the renewal email before the other cardholders were notified.
examples.zh: 其他持卡人收到通知前，「主会员」先收到了续费邮件。

examples.en: Only the primary member could view the billing details on our shared plan.
examples.zh: 在我们的共享方案里，只有「主会员」能查看账单详情。

words.enDefinition: another person with a card linked to an existing membership

examples.en: My sister was listed as an additional cardholder on the shared shopping account.
examples.zh: 共享购物账户把我姐姐列为「会员附卡持有人」。

examples.en: The clerk asked the additional cardholder to update the name on her card.
examples.zh: 店员请「会员附卡持有人」更新卡上的姓名。

words.enDefinition: a level within a membership programme with its own benefits or requirements

examples.en: The app showed my membership tier beside the points needed for the next level.
examples.zh: 应用在「会员等级」旁显示了升到下一级还需多少积分。

examples.en: I checked which membership tier included free delivery for large orders to campus.
examples.zh: 我查了哪个「会员等级」包含大订单校园免费配送。

words.enDefinition: the first or lowest level in a programme with several levels

examples.en: I stayed in the entry-level tier because I mainly shopped at the campus branch.
examples.zh: 我主要在校园门店购物，所以留在了「入门等级」。

examples.en: The entry-level tier included points but offered fewer options for early access.
examples.zh: 「入门等级」可以攒积分，提前购买的机会比较少。

words.enDefinition: a higher membership level offering additional or better benefits

examples.en: The premium tier included a delivery option I needed when I moved into residence.
examples.zh: 「高级会员等级」有一项配送福利，正好是我搬进宿舍时需要的。

examples.en: My flatmate checked the cost of a premium tier before upgrading her account.
examples.zh: 室友升级账户前，查了「高级会员等级」的费用。

words.enDefinition: a change to a higher membership level or a plan with more benefits

examples.en: The membership upgrade took effect just before I placed my first large order.
examples.zh: 我下第一笔大订单前不久，「会员升级」生效了。

examples.en: The cashier explained what a membership upgrade would change on my shared account.
examples.zh: 收银员说明了「会员升级」会给我的共享账户带来哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: to move your membership to a lower level with fewer benefits

examples.en: You can downgrade your membership online if the higher plan no longer suits you.
examples.zh: 如果更高的方案不再适合，你可以在线「调低会员等级」。

examples.en: The email explained when to downgrade your membership before the next payment was due.
examples.zh: 邮件说明要在下次付款前什么时候「调低会员等级」。

collocations: contact support to downgrade your membership

words.enDefinition: the required spending or points total for reaching a membership level

examples.en: I checked my shopping receipts to see whether I had reached the tier threshold.
examples.zh: 我查了购物小票，看有没有达到「升档门槛」。

examples.en: Only purchases made after September counted towards the tier threshold for my new account.
examples.zh: 只有九月以后的消费才计入我新账户的「升档门槛」。

collocations: spending that counts towards the tier threshold

words.enDefinition: to meet the continuing requirements to keep your membership level

examples.en: The statement showed how many points you need to maintain your status next year.
examples.zh: 结算单显示，明年要「保住当前会员等级」需要多少积分。

examples.en: Could you maintain your status if you took a semester off and rarely shopped there?
examples.zh: 如果你休学一学期，很少去那儿买东西，还能「保住当前会员等级」吗？

collocations: spend enough to maintain your status
earn points to maintain your status

words.enDefinition: the current standing of a membership, such as active or expired

examples.en: My membership status still showed as active after the payment deadline had passed.
examples.zh: 付款截止日过去后，我的「会员状态」仍显示有效。

examples.en: The cashier checked my membership status before applying the student offer to the order.
examples.zh: 收银员查看了我的「会员状态」，才在订单上应用学生优惠。

words.enDefinition: a membership that stopped being valid because it was not renewed

examples.en: I found an old number while looking up my lapsed membership in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用里查看「已失效的会员资格」时找到了一个旧编号。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether I wanted to reactivate the lapsed membership after moving back.
examples.zh: 店员问我搬回来后，是否想恢复「已失效的会员资格」。

words.enDefinition: to restore a membership that has expired or been inactive

examples.en: The app explains how to reactivate your membership using the email you registered before.
examples.zh: 应用说明了怎样用之前登记的邮箱「重新开通会员」。

examples.en: Could you reactivate your membership before making the first big purchase of the term?
examples.zh: 本学期第一笔大额购买前，你能先「重新开通会员」吗？

words.enDefinition: the period of time covered by a particular membership

examples.en: I checked how much time was left in my membership term after changing plans.
examples.zh: 更换方案后，我查看「会员有效期」还剩多久。

examples.en: The membership term ended during the week we were moving into our new flat.
examples.zh: 我们搬进新公寓的那一周，「会员有效期」结束了。

words.enDefinition: the twelve-month period used to count activity or benefits on a membership

examples.en: The membership year began when I joined the programme in the middle of term.
examples.zh: 我在学期过半时加入计划，「会员年度」就从那时开始。

examples.en: I checked whether last week's order counted towards the new membership year or the old one.
examples.zh: 我确认了上周的订单算在新的「会员年度」还是上一个。

words.enDefinition: the date when an existing membership is due to start another term

examples.en: The email confirmed my renewal date after I switched from the monthly plan.
examples.zh: 我换掉按月方案后，邮件确认了「会员续期日」。

examples.en: I put the renewal date in my calendar so it wouldn't surprise me during exams.
examples.zh: 我把「会员续期日」写进日历，免得考试期间突然遇到续费。

words.enDefinition: the amount charged for belonging to a membership programme

examples.en: I split the membership fee with my sister when we signed up together.
examples.zh: 我和姐姐一起注册时，平摊了「会员费」。

examples.en: The membership fee was due in the same week as our first grocery order.
examples.zh: 「会员费」与我们第一笔杂货订单在同一周到期。

words.enDefinition: to disable the option that renews a membership or subscription automatically

examples.en: I chose to turn off auto-renewal because I'd be abroad for the next term.
examples.zh: 下学期我要出国，所以决定「关闭自动续费」。

examples.en: The app confirmed I could turn off auto-renewal without losing access that week.
examples.zh: 应用确认，我可以「关闭自动续费」，那一周的使用权限照常保留。

words.enDefinition: to ask that a membership end and stop renewing

examples.en: I called the shop to cancel a membership I'd opened before moving into residence.
examples.zh: 我打电话给店里，「取消入住前开通的会员资格」。

examples.en: The help page explained how to cancel a membership registered with an old email.
examples.zh: 帮助页解释了如何「取消用旧邮箱注册的会员资格」。

words.expression: cancel at the end of the term
words.lemma: cancel at the end of the term
words.enDefinition: to end a membership after the current paid or trial period finishes
acceptedEnVariants: cancel at the end of the term

examples.en: I selected cancel at the end of the term and checked the expiry date.
examples.zh: 我选择了「到本期结束时取消」，然后核对了到期日。

examples.en: The support adviser asked whether I wanted to cancel at the end of the term.
examples.zh: 客服问我是否要「到本期结束时取消」。

collocations: choose to cancel at the end of the term
select “Cancel at the end of the term”
option to cancel at the end of the term

words.enDefinition: a label introducing the date when membership stops being active

examples.en: The account page read membership ends on June first after I turned off renewal.
examples.zh: 我关闭续费后，账户页面显示「会员资格结束于」六月一日。

examples.en: I copied the date after membership ends on into my notes about the plan.
examples.zh: 我把「会员资格结束于」后面的日期抄进了记录方案的笔记。

collocations: membership ends on the stated date

words.enDefinition: extra advantages available because someone belongs to a membership programme

examples.en: I used one of the member perks to book a delivery time after class.
examples.zh: 我用了其中一项「会员专属福利」，预约下课后的配送时段。

examples.en: The member perks included early access to the new products at our branch.
examples.zh: 「会员专属福利」包括可以提前买到我们门店的新商品。

words.enDefinition: an event that only people belonging to a particular programme can attend

examples.en: The shop held a members-only event before its new collection went on sale.
examples.zh: 新系列正式开卖前，商店举行了一场「会员专场活动」。

examples.en: I signed up for the members-only event because it was near the library.
examples.zh: 那场「会员专场活动」在图书馆附近，我就报名了。

words.enDefinition: an opportunity for members to see products before the wider public

examples.en: The clothing store sent a member preview of its new collection on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 服装店周三发来了新系列的「会员提前预览」。

examples.en: I saved the shoes from the member preview to look at again later.
examples.zh: 我把「会员提前预览」里看到的鞋收藏起来，打算以后再看。

words.enDefinition: permission to use an offer or see products before general access begins

examples.en: The programme gave early access to students who had renewed their membership that month.
examples.zh: 当月续会的学生获得了活动的「提前开放资格」。

examples.en: My early access ended the evening before the new collection opened to everyone.
examples.zh: 新品系列向所有顾客开放的前一晚，我的「提前开放资格」结束了。

words.enDefinition: a promotion available only to members of a programme

examples.en: The email showed a member-exclusive offer for the new line of backpacks.
examples.zh: 邮件显示，新款背包有一项「会员专属优惠」。

examples.en: I missed the member-exclusive offer because I opened the message after the deadline.
examples.zh: 我在截止日期后才打开消息，错过了「会员专属优惠」。

words.enDefinition: a membership benefit offered around the member's birthday

examples.en: The birthday reward appeared in the shopping app a week before my birthday.
examples.zh: 我的生日还有一周时，购物应用里就出现了「生日奖励」。

examples.en: I used my birthday reward when I bought coffee with a classmate on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二我和同学买咖啡时，用了「生日奖励」。

words.enDefinition: a benefit offered to someone after they join a programme

examples.en: The first email said my welcome reward would appear after the initial purchase.
examples.zh: 第一封邮件说，首次消费后就会显示「入会奖励」。

examples.en: I checked the welcome reward before deciding which items to buy that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午决定买什么之前，我查看了「入会奖励」。

words.enDefinition: an extra benefit for introducing a new member who meets programme rules

examples.en: My referral bonus appeared after my classmate made her first eligible purchase at the shop.
examples.zh: 同学在店里完成第一笔符合条件的消费后，我收到了「推荐入会奖励」。

examples.en: I read the conditions for the referral bonus before inviting my flatmate to join.
examples.zh: 邀请室友加入之前，我读了「推荐入会奖励」的条件。

words.enDefinition: to invite a friend to join a programme as your referral

examples.en: The store let me refer a friend using a link from my account page.
examples.zh: 商店让我用账户页上的链接「推荐朋友加入」。

examples.en: I saw the refer a friend button beside my membership details in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用的会员资料旁看到了「推荐朋友加入」的按钮。

collocations: refer a friend to the programme

words.enDefinition: a link that records who invited a new member to sign up

examples.en: My flatmate sent me her referral link when I asked about the shop's rewards.
examples.zh: 我问起商店的奖励时，室友把她的「推荐注册链接」发给了我。

examples.en: I opened the referral link to read the signup terms before joining the programme.
examples.zh: 我在加入计划前打开「推荐注册链接」，阅读了注册条款。

collocations: sign up through a referral link

words.enDefinition: a business that offers rewards or accepts benefits from another organization's programme

examples.en: I looked for a reward partner that sold the cinema tickets near campus.
examples.zh: 我找了一家出售校园附近电影票的「奖励合作商家」。

examples.en: The app listed the café as a reward partner for the summer term.
examples.zh: 应用把那家咖啡馆列为夏季学期的「奖励合作商家」。

collocations: spend vouchers with a reward partner

words.enDefinition: an advantage a member gets from a business associated with the programme

examples.en: My favourite partner benefit was a discount at the cinema near our flat.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的「合作商家福利」是公寓附近电影院的优惠。

examples.en: The partner benefit showed under my membership details after I linked the two accounts.
examples.zh: 我关联两个账户后，「合作商家福利」显示在会员资料下方。

words.enDefinition: the part of spending that counts towards a benefit or target

examples.en: My qualifying spend excluded the delivery fee shown at the bottom of the receipt.
examples.zh: 「可计入门槛的消费额」不包括收据底部的配送费。

examples.en: The programme showed my qualifying spend for the month in the account summary.
examples.zh: 计划在账户摘要里显示了我当月「可计入门槛的消费额」。

words.enDefinition: to receive points as a reward for purchases or other qualifying activity

examples.en: I can earn points at the campus shop without carrying a separate card.
examples.zh: 我在校园商店不用带单独的卡也能「赚取积分」。

examples.en: The app showed which shops let me earn points while visiting another city.
examples.zh: 应用列出了我去另一座城市时，哪些商店能让我「赚取积分」。

words.enDefinition: units earned for purchases or other activity in a rewards programme

examples.en: I checked my loyalty points before choosing which branch to visit after class.
examples.zh: 决定下课后去哪家门店前，我查了「会员积分」。

examples.en: The retailer let me exchange loyalty points for cinema vouchers in the app.
examples.zh: 零售商允许我在应用中用「会员积分」兑换电影券。

words.enDefinition: points awarded on top of the standard reward for a purchase

examples.en: The app added bonus loyalty points when I bought the notebook on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五买笔记本时，应用发放了「额外会员积分」。

examples.en: My receipt separated bonus loyalty points from the points I normally earn each week.
examples.zh: 收据把「额外会员积分」与我每周正常赚的积分分开列出。

words.enDefinition: twice the number of points normally awarded for a transaction

examples.en: A sign at the checkout offered double points to members during the weekend.
examples.zh: 收银台的告示写着，会员周末可获「双倍积分」。

examples.en: The app showed double points for stationery but the usual rate for everything else.
examples.zh: 应用显示文具可获「双倍积分」，其他商品仍按平时的比率。

words.enDefinition: a number used to multiply the points normally earned on a transaction

examples.en: The points multiplier for online orders changed when the spring promotion finished last month.
examples.zh: 上个月春季活动结束时，线上订单的「积分倍数」变了。

examples.en: I checked which points multiplier applied before splitting the order with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 和室友分单前，我查了适用的「积分倍数」。

words.enDefinition: the number of points a programme awards per unit of spending or activity

examples.en: The earn rate was higher on groceries than on orders placed through partner shops.
examples.zh: 杂货消费的「积分累积比率」比通过合作店铺下单高。

examples.en: I compared the earn rate with the value of vouchers in both loyalty programmes.
examples.zh: 我比较了两个会员计划的「积分累积比率」和优惠券价值。

words.enDefinition: the usual points earned before any promotional points or bonuses are added

examples.en: The statement showed base points from each purchase and listed the bonuses separately.
examples.zh: 结算单显示每笔消费的「基础积分」，并另列额外积分。

examples.en: I received the base points for my order even after the promotion ended.
examples.zh: 即使活动结束了，我仍收到了这笔订单的「基础积分」。

words.enDefinition: the number of points remaining credited to a member's account

examples.en: The app updated my points balance a day after I returned the jacket.
examples.zh: 我退回夹克一天后，应用更新了我的「积分余额」。

examples.en: I checked my points balance before joining the queue at the campus branch.
examples.zh: 在校园门店排队前，我查了「积分余额」。

words.enDefinition: points already credited and ready to be redeemed

examples.en: I used my available points to reduce the price of a notebook at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，我用「可用积分」抵扣了笔记本的一部分价格。

examples.en: The account displayed available points separately from rewards waiting to be confirmed that week.
examples.zh: 账户把「可用积分」与那周等待确认的奖励分开显示。

words.enDefinition: points that have been recorded but are not yet available to spend

examples.en: The pending points appeared after I collected my order from the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我从校园商店取完订单后，页面显示了「待入账积分」。

examples.en: I checked whether the pending points would become available before my next grocery trip.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「待入账积分」能否在下次买菜前到账。

words.enDefinition: points expected from eligible activity that have not been credited

examples.en: I reported missing points after the receipt failed to appear in my account.
examples.zh: 收据没有出现在账户里，便提交了「积分未到账」的查询。

examples.en: The adviser asked which purchase was connected to the missing points I had reported.
examples.zh: 客服询问，我报的「未到账积分」对应哪笔消费。

words.enDefinition: to credit points using a receipt from an earlier purchase

examples.en: The cashier explained whether I could add points from a receipt after forgetting my card.
examples.zh: 我忘了带卡，收银员解释了是否能「凭小票补录积分」。

examples.en: I brought the paper slip back to add points from a receipt the next day.
examples.zh: 第二天，我把纸质小票拿回店里「凭小票补录积分」。

collocations: option to add points from a receipt
ask staff to add points from a receipt
add points from a receipt online

words.enDefinition: the date on which earned points are credited to an account

examples.en: The points posting date was one day later than the date on my receipt.
examples.zh: 「积分入账日期」比小票上的日期晚一天。

examples.en: I checked the points posting date before asking the store about the missing reward.
examples.zh: 我查了「积分入账日期」，才向店家询问没有收到的奖励。

words.enDefinition: the history of points earned, used, or removed from an account

examples.en: The app showed a new line in my points activity after the returned item was scanned.
examples.zh: 退回的商品被扫码后，应用里的「积分变动记录」多了一行。

examples.en: I reviewed my points activity to see which rewards I had already used.
examples.zh: 我查看了「积分变动记录」，确认哪些奖励已经用掉。

words.enDefinition: a statement summarizing points earned or used over a period

examples.en: My points statement arrived after the programme closed the monthly collection period on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五计划结束当月攒积分周期后，我收到了「积分结算单」。

examples.en: The points statement showed the points from each visit to the supermarket near campus.
examples.zh: 「积分结算单」列出了我每次去校园附近超市获得的积分。

words.enDefinition: a change made to fix or update the points on an account

examples.en: The store made a points adjustment after confirming someone had entered my account details incorrectly.
examples.zh: 商店确认有人填错我的账户信息后，做了「积分调整」。

examples.en: I noticed a points adjustment in the account history after sending the support team my receipt.
examples.zh: 我把小票发给客服后，在账户记录里看到了「积分调整」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying points were removed from the account's balance

examples.en: The app showed points deducted after I returned the shoes to the store.
examples.zh: 我把鞋退回商店后，应用显示「积分已扣除」。

examples.en: I checked the points deducted line against the voucher I used the previous week.
examples.zh: 我用上一周用掉的优惠券核对了「积分已扣除」这一行。

words.enDefinition: a status showing points were lost because programme conditions were not met

examples.en: The closing statement showed points forfeited beside the amount I had never redeemed.
examples.zh: 结算单在我一直没兑换的数量旁写着「积分已被取消」。

examples.en: I checked why the account said points forfeited after the membership was closed.
examples.zh: 我查了为何会员注销后，账户显示「积分已被取消」。

collocations: points forfeited under the programme rules

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying points stop being usable after a stated time

examples.en: The app told me my points expire just after the start of term.
examples.zh: 应用告诉我，「我的积分将于开学后不久失效」。

examples.en: I checked whether unused points expire when I take a break from shopping there.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，一段时间不去那儿购物，「未用的积分会不会失效」。

collocations: points expire at the end of the year

words.enDefinition: the day when a group of earned points can no longer be used

examples.en: I copied the points expiration date into my calendar beside the next holiday.
examples.zh: 我把「积分失效日期」抄进了日历，记在下一个假期旁边。

examples.en: The points expiration date shown on the receipt was different from the one online.
examples.zh: 小票上的「积分失效日期」与网上看到的不一样。

words.enDefinition: a status saying unused points were carried into a new collection period

examples.en: The app listed the points rolled over from December on the first January statement.
examples.zh: 应用在一月第一张结算单里列出了十二月「已结转的积分」。

examples.en: When I checked my balance, I saw that my points rolled over into January.
examples.zh: 我查余额时看到，自己的「积分已结转」到一月。

collocations: points rolled over from last month
points rolled over into the next period

words.enDefinition: a set period during which a programme counts points earned by members

examples.en: The collection period ended before I made my final purchase of the term.
examples.zh: 我下本学期最后一笔单前，「积分累积周期」已经结束了。

examples.en: I checked which collection period included my first order from the new address.
examples.zh: 我查了一下从新地址下的第一笔订单属于哪个「积分累积周期」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum balance or other level required before a reward can be claimed

examples.en: I reached the redemption threshold after buying textbooks at one of the partner shops.
examples.zh: 我在一家合作商店买完教材后，达到了「兑换门槛」。

examples.en: The redemption threshold for a cinema voucher was lower than I had expected.
examples.zh: 电影券的「兑换门槛」比我预想的低。

words.enDefinition: to exchange earned points for a voucher that can be used later

examples.en: I chose to convert points to a voucher before ordering the new desk lamp.
examples.zh: 下单买新台灯前，我选择「把积分换成优惠券」。

examples.en: The app explained when I could convert points to a voucher for the first time.
examples.zh: 应用告诉我，什么时候可以第一次「把积分换成优惠券」。

collocations: option to convert points to a voucher
convert points to a voucher online
choose to convert points to a voucher

words.enDefinition: the amount of value or reward obtained for a set number of points

examples.en: I compared the redemption rate for groceries with the rate for cinema vouchers.
examples.zh: 我对比了杂货和电影券的「积分兑换比率」。

examples.en: The app showed a higher redemption rate when I selected an offer from a partner.
examples.zh: 我选合作商家的优惠时，应用显示了较高的「积分兑换比率」。

words.enDefinition: the process of using points or an entitlement to claim a benefit

examples.en: The reward redemption showed in my activity history on the next business day.
examples.zh: 「奖励兑换」在下一个工作日出现在我的活动记录里。

examples.en: The store's reward redemption page listed which items were available for the term.
examples.zh: 商店的「奖励兑换」页面列出了本学期可兑换的商品。

words.enDefinition: to use points in exchange for a reward or a reduction in price

examples.en: I waited until the app showed my balance before trying to redeem points.
examples.zh: 我等应用显示余额后，才试着「使用积分兑换」商品。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted to redeem points toward the cost of my order.
examples.zh: 收银员问我是否要「使用积分兑换」抵扣这笔订单的部分金额。

words.enDefinition: to claim or use a benefit that has been made available

examples.en: I chose to redeem a reward for a free drink after my seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我选择「使用一项奖励」，领了一杯免费的饮料。

examples.en: Ask the cashier if you want to redeem a reward from the app.
examples.zh: 如果想「使用一项奖励」，可以问收银员能否使用应用里的奖励。

collocations: choose when to redeem a reward

words.enDefinition: a payment option combining points with money for the remaining price

examples.en: I selected points plus cash because my points did not cover the entire order.
examples.zh: 我的积分不够付整单，便选择了「积分加现金」。

examples.en: The points plus cash option was listed below the voucher price in the app.
examples.zh: 应用把「积分加现金」列在优惠券价格下方。

words.enDefinition: using only part of a points or reward balance in a transaction

examples.en: I chose a partial redemption and saved some points for the next order.
examples.zh: 我用「部分兑换」，留了一些积分给下一笔订单。

examples.en: The statement recorded a partial redemption even though the order contained several different items.
examples.zh: 虽然订单里有好几件不同的商品，结算单还是只记录了一次「部分兑换」。

words.enDefinition: points that a member has earned but has not used for a reward

examples.en: I still had unredeemed points when I checked the balance at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末查余额时，我还有「尚未兑换的积分」。

examples.en: The account page listed my unredeemed points separately from points that had already expired.
examples.zh: 账户页把「尚未兑换的积分」与已经失效的积分分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to move points from one member or account to another

examples.en: I checked whether the programme let me transfer points to a family member.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，这个计划是否允许「转移积分」给家人。

examples.en: The clerk asked which account should receive them before agreeing to transfer points.
examples.zh: 店员先问积分转到哪个账户，才同意「转移积分」。

words.enDefinition: to put points from several people into a shared balance for redemption

examples.en: Our household could pool points for a larger reward at the end of each year.
examples.zh: 我们家可以「合并多人积分使用」，在每年年底换一项更大的奖励。

examples.en: I asked whether flatmates were allowed to pool points under the membership rules.
examples.zh: 我问根据会员规则，室友能不能「合并积分使用」。

words.enDefinition: a list of goods or benefits that members can claim as rewards

examples.en: I checked the reward catalogue for something my flatmate could use on campus.
examples.zh: 我查看了「奖励兑换目录」，想找点室友在学校用得上的东西。

examples.en: The reward catalogue listed cinema tickets and vouchers from several local shops in June.
examples.zh: 六月的「奖励兑换目录」列有电影票和几家本地商店的优惠券。

words.enDefinition: a voucher issued through a programme to give the member a benefit

examples.en: I used a reward voucher when I picked up the order at the store.
examples.zh: 我在门店取货时用了一张「奖励兑换券」。

examples.en: The reward voucher appeared underneath my membership barcode on the phone screen.
examples.zh: 手机屏幕上，「奖励兑换券」显示在我的会员条码下方。

words.enDefinition: a set of characters entered to claim a particular benefit

examples.en: I copied the reward code from the membership email into the app on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五，我把会员邮件里的「奖励兑换码」复制到应用中。

examples.en: The cashier checked whether the reward code was still active before accepting the voucher.
examples.zh: 收银员先确认「奖励兑换码」是否仍有效，才收下优惠券。

words.enDefinition: a reward available to a member that has not been applied or claimed

examples.en: I found an unused reward in the app after checking my birthday messages.
examples.zh: 我看过生日消息后，在应用中发现了一项「未使用的奖励」。

examples.en: The expiry reminder showed which unused reward would be removed first from my account.
examples.zh: 到期提醒显示，哪项「未使用的奖励」会最先从我的账户中移除。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating an offer or benefit cannot be used as money itself

examples.en: The voucher said no cash value in small print below the expiry date.
examples.zh: 优惠券在到期日下面用小字写着「无现金价值」。

examples.en: I noticed the words no cash value after I opened the digital reward.
examples.zh: 打开电子奖励后，我注意到有「无现金价值」几个字。

words.enDefinition: a benefit that can be earned or used only once

examples.en: The signup email included a one-time reward to use on my next purchase.
examples.zh: 注册邮件附有一项「一次性奖励」，下次购物可以用。

examples.en: I checked the one-time reward before deciding which order to apply it to.
examples.zh: 我查看了「一次性奖励」，才决定把它用在哪一笔订单上。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating a benefit has already been claimed or used

examples.en: The screen showed reward redeemed next to the voucher after I paid for lunch.
examples.zh: 我付完午餐钱后，屏幕在券旁显示「奖励已兑换」。

examples.en: I saved the reward redeemed confirmation because the cashier's receipt was hard to read.
examples.zh: 收银台的小票看不清，我保存了「奖励已兑换」的确认信息。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a listed reward cannot currently be claimed

examples.en: The app said reward unavailable after the partner shop used its last cinema voucher.
examples.zh: 合作商店发完最后一张电影券后，应用显示「奖励目前不可用」。

examples.en: I saw reward unavailable beside the item when I opened the catalogue that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上打开目录时，我看到商品旁写着「奖励目前不可用」。

words.enDefinition: the written rules describing how a membership programme works

examples.en: I read the programme terms before agreeing to link my shopping account with the app.
examples.zh: 同意把购物账户与应用关联前，我读了「计划条款」。

examples.en: The programme terms explained when the store would remove points after a return.
examples.zh: 「计划条款」说明了退货后商家什么时候会扣回积分。

words.enDefinition: products or situations to which membership benefits do not apply

examples.en: I looked at the membership exclusions before ordering a rechargeable battery for class.
examples.zh: 给课堂买充电电池前，我查看了「会员福利除外项」。

examples.en: The help page listed membership exclusions separately from the rules for earning points.
examples.zh: 帮助页把「会员福利除外项」与攒积分的规则分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to combine several rewards in the same purchase or redemption

examples.en: I asked whether I could stack rewards with my birthday voucher on this order.
examples.zh: 我问这笔订单能否和生日券一起「叠加使用奖励」。

examples.en: The shop showed which offers let members stack rewards on the same purchase.
examples.zh: 商店列出了哪些优惠允许会员在同一笔消费中「叠加使用奖励」。

words.enDefinition: membership made available under a programme especially for students

examples.en: I applied for student membership when my university email account was ready to use.
examples.zh: 学校邮箱可以使用后，我申请了「学生会员资格」。

examples.en: The shop explained when my student membership would end after I left university.
examples.zh: 店家解释了我离开学校后，「学生会员资格」什么时候会结束。

words.enDefinition: a price schedule reserved for students, often for a separate plan or product

examples.en: The website displayed student pricing after I verified my university email address.
examples.zh: 验证学校邮箱地址后，网站显示了「学生专属定价」。

examples.en: I compared the student pricing with the standard monthly plan before signing up.
examples.zh: 注册前，我把「学生专属定价」与普通月费方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the conditions someone must meet to receive a benefit offered to students

examples.en: I read the student eligibility rules before trying to join with my exchange registration.
examples.zh: 我先看了「学生资格条件」，再尝试用交换生的注册记录加入。

examples.en: The store explained its student eligibility rules next to the form for discounted membership.
examples.zh: 商店在优惠会员表格旁解释了「学生资格条件」。

words.enDefinition: to check records that show whether someone currently qualifies as a student

examples.en: The retailer asked the service to verify student status before applying the special price.
examples.zh: 零售商先请服务机构「核验学生身份」，才使用特价。

examples.en: The website explained how to verify student status using an enrolment letter from university.
examples.zh: 网站说明了如何用学校的注册证明「核验学生身份」。

collocations: use documents to verify student status

words.enDefinition: someone whose current student status has been confirmed by a checking process

examples.en: The retailer showed me as a verified student when I opened the account settings.
examples.zh: 我打开账户设置时，零售商显示我为「身份已核验的学生」。

examples.en: Each verified student could see the academic offer on their own shopping account.
examples.zh: 每位「身份已核验的学生」都能在自己的购物账户里看到学生优惠。

collocations: show someone as a verified student

words.enDefinition: an email address associated with an educational institution and issued for student use

examples.en: The form accepted my student email address before asking for the year I would finish.
examples.zh: 表格接受了我的「学生邮箱地址」，之后问我哪年毕业。

examples.en: I used a different student email address after switching to the other campus.
examples.zh: 转到另一个校区后，我用了不同的「学生邮箱地址」。

words.enDefinition: an organization that checks someone meets a programme's eligibility rules

examples.en: The shop sent me to a verification provider to confirm my graduate student status.
examples.zh: 商店把我转给一家「核验服务机构」，以确认我的研究生身份。

examples.en: I checked the name of the verification provider before submitting my enrolment letter.
examples.zh: 递交注册证明前，我先核对了「核验服务机构」的名称。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a verification request has yet to be completed

examples.en: The account said verification pending after I uploaded my registration letter on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日上传注册证明后，账户显示「等待核验」。

examples.en: I saw verification pending beside my student membership request when I checked again.
examples.zh: 我再次查看时，看到学生会员申请旁写着「等待核验」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the requested check was completed and accepted

examples.en: The page displayed verified successfully just before the student offer appeared on my account.
examples.zh: 学生优惠在账户中出现前，页面先显示了「核验成功」。

examples.en: I saved the verified successfully message in case I needed it at the checkout desk.
examples.zh: 我保存了「核验成功」的消息，以防结账柜台用得上。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the submitted details did not pass a verification check

examples.en: The form displayed verification unsuccessful when my old email address no longer matched the records.
examples.zh: 旧邮箱地址与记录不再一致时，表格显示「核验未通过」。

examples.en: I received a message saying “Verification unsuccessful” after leaving out my current term dates.
examples.zh: 我漏填当前学期的起止日期后，收到一条写着「核验未通过」的消息。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a previous verification is no longer accepted

examples.en: The app showed verification expired even though I was still attending classes that month.
examples.zh: 虽然我那个月还在上课，应用却显示「核验结果已过期」。

examples.en: A verification expired notice appeared when I tried to apply the student rate again.
examples.zh: 我再次尝试使用学生价格时，出现了「核验结果已过期」的通知。

words.enDefinition: to check a student's eligibility again after an earlier check

examples.en: The store said it needed to reverify student status at the start of term.
examples.zh: 商店说，开学时需要「重新核验学生身份」。

examples.en: I read the instructions on how to reverify student status after changing universities.
examples.zh: 转学后，我看了有关怎样「重新核验学生身份」的说明。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a member has asked to suspend their benefits temporarily

examples.en: My account showed “Membership paused” after I requested a break during my exchange.
examples.zh: 我申请在交换学习期间暂停会员后，账户显示「会员已暂停」。

examples.en: I checked the membership paused notice after changing my travel plans for the summer.
examples.zh: 暑期出行计划变了以后，我查看了「会员已暂停」的通知。

words.enDefinition: to start using a membership again after it was paused

examples.en: The app showed a button to resume your membership on the plan settings page.
examples.zh: 应用在方案设置页显示了「恢复会员资格」按钮。

examples.en: The email said you could resume your membership whenever you returned to campus.
examples.zh: 邮件说，只要回到学校，就可以「恢复会员资格」。

words.enDefinition: the step that makes a particular membership benefit available for use

examples.en: I completed benefit activation before booking my first grocery delivery for the semester.
examples.zh: 我先完成「福利开通」，才预约本学期第一次送货上门。

examples.en: The account showed the date of benefit activation under my partner offer details.
examples.zh: 账户在合作商家优惠详情下方显示了「福利开通」的日期。

words.enDefinition: to actively choose to receive or take part in an offer

examples.en: I opened the member dashboard to opt into an offer before buying the printer.
examples.zh: 买打印机之前，我打开会员页面，「主动参加了一项优惠活动」。

examples.en: The assistant asked if I wanted to opt into an offer for campus delivery.
examples.zh: 关于校园配送，店员问我是否愿意「主动参加优惠活动」。

collocations: choose to opt into an offer
prompt to opt into an offer

words.enDefinition: messages a programme sends to its members about the account or benefits

examples.en: The shop moved updates about points expiry into member communications in the app.
examples.zh: 商店把积分到期消息移到了应用里「发送给会员的通知」栏目。

examples.en: I looked at member communications for the date of the next preview event.
examples.zh: 我看了「发送给会员的通知」，查找下一次预览活动的日期。

words.enDefinition: to choose to stop receiving marketing messages by email

examples.en: I decided to opt out of promotional emails after moving away from the local branch.
examples.zh: 搬离那家门店附近后，我决定「退订促销邮件」。

examples.en: The store let me opt out of promotional emails while keeping my digital receipts.
examples.zh: 商店允许我「退订促销邮件」，电子收据仍照常接收。

collocations: choose to opt out of promotional emails
option to opt out of promotional emails
click to opt out of promotional emails

words.enDefinition: to associate a rewards card with an account or app

examples.en: The cashier explained how to link a loyalty card when I replaced my phone.
examples.zh: 我换手机时，收银员解释了如何「绑定积分卡」。

examples.en: The app asked if I wanted to link a loyalty card before the checkout page.
examples.zh: 应用进入结账页前，问我是否要「绑定积分卡」。

collocations: link a loyalty card to an account
choose to link a loyalty card
prompt to link a loyalty card

words.enDefinition: to combine separate accounts for the same rewards programme into one account

examples.en: I asked the shop whether it could merge loyalty accounts created under two emails.
examples.zh: 我问商店能否「合并用两个邮箱开的会员积分账户」。

examples.en: The help page explained which points would transfer when staff merge loyalty accounts.
examples.zh: 帮助页说明了工作人员「合并会员积分账户」时，哪些积分会跟着转移。

words.enDefinition: the contact details and preferences saved for a participant in a programme

examples.en: I changed the address in my member profile after moving into the new flat.
examples.zh: 搬进新公寓后，我改了「会员资料」里的地址。

examples.en: The cashier checked the phone number in my member profile during the enquiry.
examples.zh: 查询时，收银员核对了「会员资料」里的电话号码。

words.enDefinition: a message sent before a membership is due to be renewed

examples.en: The membership renewal reminder arrived the week before I was due to leave campus.
examples.zh: 我预定离校的前一周，收到了「会员续费提醒」。

examples.en: I opened the membership renewal reminder to check which plan I had selected.
examples.zh: 我打开「会员续费提醒」，核对选择的是哪个方案。

words.enDefinition: a membership bought or arranged for someone else as a gift

examples.en: My friends bought a gift membership for me before my first year abroad.
examples.zh: 我出国读第一学年前，朋友给我买了一份「赠送的会员资格」。

examples.en: The store emailed the details of the gift membership directly to my sister.
examples.zh: 商店把「赠送的会员资格」详情直接发邮件给了姐姐。

words.enDefinition: an additional membership card issued to someone at the main member's address

examples.en: My sister collected her household card after the clerk confirmed our shared address.
examples.zh: 店员确认我们同住的地址后，姐姐领取了「同住成员附卡」。

examples.en: I checked whether the household card had the same expiry as the main one.
examples.zh: 我查了「同住成员附卡」和主卡的到期日期是否相同。

words.enDefinition: a voucher that can be exchanged for a membership or membership period

examples.en: I entered the membership voucher from the welcome pack after creating a shopping account.
examples.zh: 创建购物账户后，我输入了迎新材料里的「会员兑换券」号码。

examples.en: The membership voucher covered my first term but needed to be used before October.
examples.zh: 「会员兑换券」覆盖我的第一个学期，但必须在十月前使用。

words.enDefinition: a status showing membership is temporarily inactive pending a decision or change

examples.en: The membership office left my membership on hold while I sent updated university details.
examples.zh: 我提交更新的学校资料期间，会员办公室把我的「会员资格暂时搁置」。

examples.en: My account said membership on hold after the shop requested a new verification letter.
examples.zh: 商店要求提供新的核验函后，我的账户显示「会员资格暂时搁置」。

words.enDefinition: a message warning that a reward will soon stop being usable

examples.en: I received a reward expiry reminder about the cinema voucher I'd saved for later.
examples.zh: 我收到了一条「奖励到期提醒」，说的是我留着以后用的电影券。

examples.en: The reward expiry reminder included a link to the list of participating branches.
examples.zh: 「奖励到期提醒」附有参加活动的门店列表链接。

words.enDefinition: a status showing previously removed points were returned to the balance

examples.en: The app showed points reinstated after the shop cancelled the order I had placed.
examples.zh: 商店取消我下的订单后，应用显示「积分已恢复」。

examples.en: I compared the points reinstated entry with the amount taken off my earlier balance.
examples.zh: 我把「积分已恢复」这一项与之前从余额扣掉的数量进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: the smallest number of points allowed in a transfer between accounts

examples.en: I checked the minimum points per transfer before deciding whether to share my balance.
examples.zh: 决定要不要分享积分余额前，我查看了「每次转移积分的下限」。

examples.en: The form showed the minimum points per transfer below the recipient's membership number.
examples.zh: 表格在收取方会员编号下方标明了「每次转移积分的下限」。

collocations: check the minimum points per transfer
raise the minimum points per transfer
state the minimum points per transfer

words.enDefinition: a membership whose benefits apply through online channels only

examples.en: I chose an online-only membership because the nearest store was across the city.
examples.zh: 最近的门店在城市另一头，所以我选了「仅限线上使用的会员」。

examples.en: The online-only membership offered delivery benefits rather than discounts at the physical checkout.
examples.zh: 「仅限线上使用的会员」提供送货福利，店内结账没有优惠。

collocations: sign up for an online-only membership

words.enDefinition: a scheduled delivery time reserved for customers in a programme

examples.en: I booked a member-only delivery slot because I had a late class that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚有晚课，我预约了一个「会员专用配送时段」。

examples.en: The app offered a member-only delivery slot near the end of the afternoon.
examples.zh: 应用提供了一个接近傍晚的「会员专用配送时段」。

words.enDefinition: a page showing a member's points, offers, and reward activity

examples.en: I checked the rewards dashboard before deciding whether to use the voucher at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时决定要不要用优惠券前，我查看了「奖励管理页面」。

examples.en: My rewards dashboard still showed the bookmark I had saved before replacing my phone.
examples.zh: 换了手机之后，我的「奖励管理页面」仍显示之前收藏的那项奖励。

words.enDefinition: to change from free or trial access to a membership that requires payment

examples.en: I checked when the trial would convert to a paid membership after signing up.
examples.zh: 注册后，我查了试用资格什么时候会「转为付费会员」。

examples.en: The help page explained which benefits changed if I chose to convert to a paid membership.
examples.zh: 帮助页解释了如果选择「转为付费会员」，有哪些福利会变化。

collocations: choose to convert to a paid membership
automatically convert to a paid membership
trial set to convert to a paid membership
